title: Shin 2004: normalised lumbar extensor EMG vs trunk and knee angle, static, no load
condition: static trunk flexion 30/50/70/90 deg x knee flexion 0/20/40 deg, no external load

quantity.name: normalised lumbar extensor EMG
quantity.definition: mean EMG normalised to the posture(angle)-specific maximum voluntary trunk extension (fraction of MVC, 0-1); group mean of 8 subjects (no SD plotted)

source.authors: Shin G, Shu Y, Li Z, Jiang Z, Mirka G
source.sample: 8 healthy males; flexibility groups 3 high / 3 mid / 2 low

protocol.summary: Static postures held while EMG recorded; posture-specific MVCs for normalisation; 48 trials (2 load conditions; only no-load digitised here).
how_to_simulate: Scale to male, 27 y, 174 cm, 68.5 kg
Static posture: trunk flexion (data[].trunk_deg) with knee flexion (data[].knee_deg)
Output: activation of multifidus (L4), longissimus and iliocostalis (L2) normalised to the same posture's maximal extension capacity; expect the drop at 70-90 deg (flexion-relaxation)
protocol.notes: Right-side surface electrodes, 2.5 cm inter-electrode. Trunk angle definition: torso flexion from upright (paper's Fig 1). The 50%-MVC loaded condition (Fig 3) was not digitised.
